changelog: ☁️ Phase 23: Antigravity Cloud Agents & Cloud Web Preview.
🌐 Cloud Agents & Remote VM: Antigravity chat support in Google-managed VMs with GitHub repository checkout and persistent background execution.
🚀 Native Rust Reverse Proxy: Pure Tokio/Axum streaming reverse proxy (/api/cloud/preview/:port/*) with zero-copy forwarding and automatic CORS header rewriting.
📱 In-App Web Preview & Sandbox: Live WebView preview dialog with port detection, CORS bypass, and system browser loopback proxy (CloudPreviewServer).
🔍 Active Port Scanner: Background TCP port scanner (/api/cloud/ports/scan) detecting active local and cloud development servers.
